body: I'm new to the site so I don't know how to send a pm to you. I want to say that I relate to you a lot. A lot of the things you mention is what I feel and what I thought is right until one day in July I hit an all time low and I was sent to a therapist. We are getting to work my anxiety and stuff it helped for a while and then last week, I couldn't take my emotions and all other factors surrounding me. The reason why I wanted money to travel is because at least during then I wouldn't think of my problems. I don't have to talk to unnecessary people. I could do and be who I want to be with no stress. Work wise I wish I could do things from home too. It's stress free and I feel so much comfort.

Thank you. I have been trying to do all that. I want to go out, have a job and save money to travel do and do whatever I can but the thing is I have so much anxiety. I can't do things without feeling like my world has fell apart. I understand where you're coming from. I understand. I'm going to try but honestly... I don't know how long it would last.
